verdict.rationale: The only official SDK evidence is a first-party React hook and component for embedding Teller Connect in the tellerhq GitHub org, backed by docs on integrating Connect. The core API is documented as raw mTLS-authenticated HTTP endpoints. Probes found no OpenAPI spec that could be used to generate clients. Missing for 10: official server-side SDKs for the balances, transactions, identity and payments APIs, multi-language SDK coverage, SDK reference documentation, an OpenAPI spec for codegen, and independent hands-on corroboration of the SDKs.
